## Technical Corrections to This Historical Draft

This source is retained for audit history and is excluded from the production reading path. The corrections below govern its interpretation; the original wording is preserved separately.

For a differentiable system, the first variation around a declared nominal solution is linear. The original finite dynamics remain nonlinear; their origin is the specified vector field, not curvature alone. Tangent spaces and curvature describe geometric properties, while forces, constraints, dissipation and controls specify the mechanical evolution. The canonical series separates these roles and states the additional assumptions for finite predictions.

Current reading path: [Canonical Series Article](/articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-1-geometry.html).

## Thesis

Nonlinear systems are exactly linear in the infinitesimal.

Superposition lives in the tangent space.
Dynamics emerge from curvature.

:::
